svg.title: RAG ingestion gap diagram
svg.desc: Shows what exists vs what is missing in the RAG pipeline for the data governance copilot

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What document formats should we support for ingestion?')
sendPrompt('How do we ingest Excel data into RAG?')
sendPrompt('How do we ingest Confluence pages into RAG?')
sendPrompt('How do we ingest Collibra data into RAG?')
sendPrompt('How do we ingest raw text into RAG?')
sendPrompt('How does the document loader work in LangChain?')
sendPrompt('What chunking strategy should we use for governance docs?')
sendPrompt('What embedding model should we use for governance documents?')
sendPrompt('How do we store metadata alongside embeddings in pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How does the KnowledgeAgent query pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How does pgvector similarity search work?')
sendPrompt('How does the NullVectorStore work in dev mode?')
sendPrompt('How does the synthesizer use knowledge agent results?')

svg.text: Two options: CLI script (one-shot batch) + FastAPI endpoint (upload on demand)
